dedupe_keys.name: bluebonnet oil and gas well production model

description: Bluebonnet is a Python package for analysing and forecasting production from unconventional oil and gas wells. It uses scaled solutions of a pressure-diffusivity equation to history-match past rates and compare future production scenarios, including wells influenced by hydraulic fracturing. Geographic coverage and forecast period depend on the well records and assumptions supplied; the package is not a public production database. The own repository and documentation are BSD-3-Clause. Forecast profiles can inform upstream energy-supply scenarios or asset-capacity simulations. A caveat is that well behaviour depends on geology, phase interactions and engineering decisions, and a history match is not proof of a unique future forecast. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS summary, own repository and README were checked without obtaining production records or running a model.
name: Bluebonnet oil and gas well production model
